verdict.rationale: Square's developer docs show broad API coverage matching most UI functions—payments, catalog, inventory, orders, locations, disputes, webhooks, payouts, team management, terminal hardware—suggesting strong but not fully verified parity with the merchant dashboard. However, a community report flags a functional gap (no native subscriptions/recurring billing) and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (404s), so there's no evidence of complete UI-API parity. missing for 10: explicit parity confirmation, subscriptions/recurring billing API, machine-readable spec proving full endpoint coverage.
